sources.entry: SandBase CLI - Open-source CLI and MCP bridge for OpenAI-compatible access to 2,000+ AI models through usage-based pricing and a free plan. #freemium #opensource

summary.one_liner: SandBase CLI (@sandbaseai/cli) is an Apache-2.0 command-line tool that connects AI coding agents to 2,000+ AI models and data APIs through a local MCP bridge.
summary.what_it_does: Running `connect` opens a browser sign-in, saves an API key locally with 0600 permissions, and configures a local MCP bridge for supported AI clients. The bridge exposes SandBase tools (discover, inspect, run, run_get, runs, account, run_cancel) so an agent can search the catalog, read schemas and pricing, and execute models or APIs. The README also describes a shell transport with equivalent commands (discover, inspect, run, runs, balance, upload) for agents without MCP. Data APIs get 100 free calls per organization per UTC day, then are billed per call; models are paid per call or per token. Discovery, inspection, run status, and balance checks are free. The README lists 25 client targets, including Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, and Hermes, with auto-configuration for many and manual setup for ChatGPT and Claude Desktop.
use_cases: connect coding agents to web search and social media data
generate images or video from an agent
call LLMs like GPT-4o or Claude without managing separate API keys
research e-commerce prices or stock and company data
transcribe audio or generate speech from a shell script
notable: One-command setup that configures many AI clients, with doctor and unregister commands that only touch SandBase-owned config
Discover-then-inspect-then-run workflow where discovery and inspection are free and show live pricing before any paid call
Shell transport mirrors MCP tools for agents without MCP support, with JSON output and exit codes
Published SHA-256 checksums per release so an exact tarball build can be pinned and verified
caveats: Requires a SandBase account and browser sign-in; paid models and data APIs beyond the daily free quota are billed per call
Depends on the hosted api.sandbase.ai service; if it is unreachable, tools stay visible but return errors
OpenClaw has no supported Skill removal command, so unregister leaves the Skill installed
